mapper.select: WITH per_oc AS ( SELECT faction_id, oc_name, "rank", oc_id, MAX(CASE WHEN is_success THEN total_reward ELSE 0 END) AS reward, SUM(item_cost) AS item_cost, MAX(CASE WHEN is_success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_flag FROM torn_faction_oc_income WHERE deleted = 0 AND faction_id = #{factionId} GROUP BY faction_id, oc_name, "rank", oc_id ) SELECT faction_id AS factionId, oc_name AS ocName, "rank" AS "rank", COUNT(*) AS attemptCount, SUM(success_flag) AS successCount, SUM(reward) - SUM(item_cost) AS netRewardSum FROM per_oc GROUP BY faction_id, oc_name, "rank"
